seq = "".join(l for l in open("region.fasta") if not l.startswith(">")).replace("\n","")

core_pos=[m.start() for m in re.finditer("(?=GTTCCCCGC)",seq)]  # 13

print("Alignment (core-6 to core+30):")
for p in core_pos:
    print(f"{p:5d} {seq[p-6:p+30]}")
print("      " + " "*6 + "^core")

# per-column conservation across the window
W0,W1=-6,32
cols=[[seq[p+o] for p in core_pos] for o in range(W0,W1)]
print("\nPer-column consensus (offset: base composition):")
for o,c in zip(range(W0,W1),cols):
    cc=Counter(c)
    cons=cc.most_common(1)[0]
    flag="" if cons[1]==13 else "  <- variable"
    print(f"  {o:+3d}: {dict(cc)} cons={cons[0]} ({cons[1]}/13){flag}")
